title: Markups

visibilityHint.project: Everyone who can see these models sees it.

empty: No markups on these models yet.
noModels: Open a model to see its markups.
noPermission: You do not have markup permission in the folders of these models.
olderHint: Made on an earlier version of these models. Carry one over to keep working on it here; a pin finds its element again by GlobalId.
olderDetail: This markup belongs to version {{version}}. Its viewpoint is shown as a picture; carry it over to open it on the current model.
carried: Carried over from an older version.
anchorMissing: The element of this pin is not in this version; the pin stays at its old position.
pickPin: Click a point in the model for the markup (Esc: cancel).
drawHint: Draw on the view; the drawing is saved with the camera.
hidden: The drawing belongs to the saved viewpoint; it was hidden when the view moved.
issueHint: The issue gets this markup's viewpoint, picture and pin, and takes them into BCF exports. A private markup is shared with the project.
confirmDelete: Delete this markup? Its comments are deleted too.
